mode.label: Verse selection
mode.description: Choose a random verse or keep one verse per local day.

refresh_minutes.label: Random refresh interval
refresh_minutes.description: Minutes between random verses; 0 disables automatic rotation.

language.label: Translation language
language.description: Choose which translation text to display.

show_credit.label: Show translation credits
show_credit.description: Display the translator and grouped verse range when available.

show_controls.label: Show controls
show_controls.description: Display previous, copy, and next buttons.

teachings_only.label: Teachings only
teachings_only.description: Limit selection to verses spoken by Shri Krishna.

font_size.label: Font size
font_size.description: Base text size; transliteration, translation, and credits scale with it.

no_verses: No verses match the current settings.
